explanation: Bounds the numeric controls of a complete wanted record. The incidence and source-size hypotheses constrain the exact numeric controls passed through a wanted-record call.
theorem_title: A seventh-power bound for wanted numeric controls
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $K\le J(n)$, $N\le3M(n)^3$, and $N_B,N_C\le n$, where $M$ is the reporting magnitude envelope. At the executable half-size and block count, $$\operatorname{wantedNumeric}\le100(M(n)+1)^7.$$

Bounds the numeric controls of a complete wanted record. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
